relationships.subject: INCB3344
relationships.evidence_quote: INCB3344 administration does not affect the mechanical allodynia (Fig. 4E) but attenuates the thermal hyperalgesia (Fig. 4F) at day 3 after CFA injection

relationships.subject: CCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggest that CCL2 rather than IL-33 itself could be the key chemoattractant to recruit those cells.

relationships.subject: AMG9810
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking TRPV1 by intraperitoneal injection selective antagonist AMG9810 (200 µL, 30 mg/kg) 30 min before IL33 induction attenuates IL-33-induced mechanical (Fig. 6E) and thermal (Fig. 6F) hypersensitivity.

relationships.subject: AMG2850
relationships.evidence_quote: blocking TRPM8 channel with selective antagonist AMG2850 (1 μg/10 μL) reduces IL-33-induced cold allodynia

relationships.subject: IL-33
relationships.evidence_quote: the mRNA levels of TRPV1, TRPV4 and TRPM8 were up-regulated in IL33-treated mice

key_findings: IL-33/ST2 drives inflammatory pain via CCL2 secreted by infiltrating macrophages and neutrophils
IL-33-induced hypersensitivity requires TRPV1 and TRPM8 activity in sensory neurons
